title: Split an e-mail address with substring

blocks.text: `substring(begin, end)` starts at `begin` and stops before `end`, so its length is `end - begin`. `substring(begin)` runs to the end of the String.
Write two methods in `Emails`, using `indexOf('@')` to find the separator:

items: `user(String email)` returns the part before the `@`: `user("ada@example.com")` is `"ada"`. With no `@`, the whole text is the user: `user("ada")` is `"ada"`.
`domain(String email)` returns the part after the `@`: `domain("ada@example.com")` is `"example.com"`. With no `@` there is no domain: `domain("ada")` is `""`.

cases.says: The domain of "ada@example.com" is "example.com", without the @.

concepts: substring(begin, end) stops before end, so its length is end - begin, and substring(begin) runs to the end.
